title: Virchow
paper_title: A Foundation Model for Clinical-Grade Computational Pathology and Rare Cancers Detection
core_mech: Virchow 是 632M ViT-H/14 的病理 tile foundation encoder，以约 150 万临床 WSI 的 DINOv2 自监督规模取胜。
core_mech_en: 632M-parameter ViT-H/14 computational pathology tile foundation model pretrained with DINOv2 on 2 billion tiles from 1.5 million clinical H&E whole-slide images.
input_desc: H&E 全切片切出的组织 tile 及其全局/局部增强视图
input_en: 224×224 H&E histopathology tissue tile (with global and local crops during pretraining)
output_desc: tile-level 632M ViT embedding；下游可经 WSI aggregator 形成病例预测
output_en: 2560-D tile representation ([CLS] concatenated with mean patch token) feeding downstream WSI aggregators

source.title: Virchow
notes: Only public model-card metadata was inspected. No gated files or pretrained weights were downloaded; code, weights and dataset terms must each be respected.
Hugging Face access is gated (auto). Each learner must obtain any required upstream access directly; this repository does not bypass gates.
Virchow's public gate text identifies Apache-2.0 and says its responsible-use guidelines are not intended to restrict Apache rights. Institutional registration is still requested by the host.

gaps: Virchow pretrained pathology representations and their data/training protocol are not reproduced by the generic DINOv2 mechanism lesson.
